The lender is leveraging its international network and capital-markets expertise to serve ultra-rich Indians with global assets, aiming for double-digit growth and deeper relationships with the country’s top promoters.

banking-economy.title: SBI sees corporate loan pipeline at Rs 5 lakh crore: CS Setty, SBI, Chairman
banking-economy.summary: The State Bank of India forecasts a significant surge in corporate loan prospects, aiming for ₹5 lakh crore as companies pivot towards investments in renewable energy and battery storage solutions. SBI remains steadfast in its goal to secure $10 billion through FCNR(B) deposits while confidently targeting a 14-15% growth in credit. With robust capital buffers, banks are better positioned to navigate future economic fluctuations.
